title: Lauren Daigle Signs With Capitol/Interscope/CCMG
summary: The singer-songwriter will launch her upcoming holiday tour in December.
contentText:
Two-time Grammy winner Lauren Daigle has signed with Capitol/Interscope/Capitol Christian Music Group (CCMG), Billboard can reveal.

Known for songs including the Billboard Hot 100 top 30 hit “You Say” and Christian Airplay chart-toppers including “Trust In You,” “Thank God I Do” and “You Say,” Daigle has also earned seven Billboard Music Awards, 10 GMA Dove Awards and four American Music Awards.

Of the new label partnership, Daigle said in a statement, “I’m really happy to be joining the Interscope / Capitol and CCMG family as we set sail for the adventure of creating new music. I have such respect for the talented visionaries leading these great companies and deeply look forward with excitement to all that is to come!”

John Janick , chairman/CEO of Interscope Capitol Label Group, added, “Lauren is the rare kind of artist who has simultaneously built an exceptionally loyal following while creating music that transcends boundaries in very powerful ways. We are so happy to have her in the Interscope Capitol family and are excited to be working with her and her incredible team.”

CCMG president Brad O’Donnell added, “Lauren is an icon, a one-of-a-kind artist with a voice and message that resonate around the world. We can’t wait to work with her and our partners at Capitol to grow her audience and build on her incredible legacy.”

Tom March , chairman/CEO of Capitol Music Group, added, “It’s been fantastic spending time with Lauren and getting to know her over these last few months. She’s brilliant and has been so welcoming.  It’s very special to be working with an artist like Lauren, who has already achieved so much in her remarkable career, but where there’s still so much further to go. We can’t wait to get started.”

Each of Daigle’s studio albums, most recently 2023’s self-titled project, has hit the pinnacle of Billboard ‘s Top Christian Albums chart. In December, Daigle will launch her 10th annual Behold Christmas Tour, which begins with two shows at Nashville’s Ryman Auditorium. She is also set to reveal upcoming holiday music.
